inputs.name: release_notes
inputs.description: The notes of one release as engineering writes them, for developers: every change of the release, with the mechanics behind it

inputs.name: style_guide
inputs.description: The company's written style guide for release posts: who reads them, what goes in and what stays out, the voice, the structure of a post and the fields the blog's CMS takes

output.description: A release post ready to paste into the blog's CMS, with what it leaves out of the release notes for the manager to check before publishing

fields.name: meta_description
fields.description: The description search engines show under the title

fields.name: excerpt
fields.description: The short summary shown on the blog's index page and in the newsletter

fields.name: body
fields.description: The body of the post in Markdown, as the CMS takes it

fields.name: left_out
fields.description: What the post leaves out of the release notes, each with the style guide's rule that leaves it out
